div.span: An Amazon EventBridge rule triggers the splitter Lambda function, which sends batches of 25 records to Amazon SQS. Failures go to dead-letter queues.

div.span: The processor Lambda function runs a Strands agent per record. Amazon Bedrock Guardrails blocks prompt attacks and masks PII, then Claude Sonnet 5 on Amazon Bedrock reasons over the record.

div.span: Results go to Amazon DynamoDB with the code, confidence, reasoning, verified source URLs, and a needs_review flag. An S3 output bucket is provided for your own exports.
